children: TriplePoint Capital's co-chief executive, Sajal Srivastava, is leaving the company at the end of the year.

The company on Monday said the transition also means Srivastava will leave his role as president, chief investment officer, and a board member for two of TriplePoint's publicly traded funds. These are TriplePoint Venture Growth BDC and TriplePoint Private Venture BDC.

TriplePoint co-CEO Jim Labe will take over as the company's sole CEO upon Srivastava's exit. The company's chief credit officer, Ian Schworer, was appointed chief investment officer of both the funds.
